fact: Minister of Environment Bernadette Arakwiye said Rwanda's LAIS electronic system holds all land and owner data and handles land registration, boundary correction and transfers, with over 800,000 files a year processed and 864,000 files received in 2025.
Minister Arakwiye said LAIS has been connected to other national systems including Irembo and the tax payment system.
The National Land Authority's land use and mapping head lists LAIS among Rwanda's digital systems, with more than 14 systems connected to it and a functioning land administration system established.
The National Land Authority presentation says Rwanda established a National Registry system (LAIS) with a spatial database.
